agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Actions 21-23 selected Bug Bite while Bugatti had a verified nonzero sleep counter. All three actions were guaranteed to do nothing, letting Leech Seed and two Sludge Bombs KO Bugatti.

resolution.observed: Hybrid-policy-v23 ranks a safe deterministic-status escape above blocked moves, permits returning to a prior teammate after the entrant has acted, and still vetoes true no-action reversals. The exact state now selects Ohmnomnom.

findings.summary: After the corrected Ohmnomnom Fake Out sacrifice, the forced-switch profile preferred still-sleeping Bugatti and forbade Birdlaw, which would have reintroduced an incapacitated battler.

resolution.observed: Sleeping/frozen switch targets are now vetoed whenever an actionable teammate exists, and the unnecessary Birdlaw hard veto was removed. Exact replay selected Birdlaw, which KO'd Sunflora in one Aerial Ace and Dustox in three, reaching authoritative victory.

findings.summary: Lildozer and Bushtank fainted after completing their Ponyta and Eelektrik damage roles; neither was switched in and out without acting.

The original branch lost Bugatti and Ohmnomnom during the prolonged Sunflora phase. The verified replacement line preserves Bugatti at 30 HP while Ohmnomnom converts its last HP into fresh-entry Fake Out.

The original seven switches were matchup entries or forced replacements, with no switch-in-and-out cycle. The corrected return to Ohmnomnom is also not churn because Bugatti used Bug Bite before becoming incapacitated.

correct_choices: All Fake Out uses were on fresh entry and produced a free hit.
Bugatti landed Bug Bite before GrassWhistle; returning to Ohmnomnom afterward is a productive status escape, not a no-action reversal.
Birdlaw's corrected terminal line uses four attacks without switching and wins authoritatively.
The original terminal state was a verified win with Croakatoa at 42 HP and Birdlaw at 7 HP, but it is rejected for qualification because of the three avoidable sleep turns.
agent_review.next_test: Restart qualification at Clone 1 with behavior hash 48575e91466ff521446c39c42a85bde6a918812b1c563141df95da626547f71b; require zero status-prevented actions, no true no-action reversals, no incapacitated forced entry, and a clean win.
